C0118.title: Jiangsu Police Uncover Traffic Hijacking Case Involving Computer System Sabotage
C0118.summary: In September 2024, the Ministry of Public Security released typical cases of cracking down on advertising-promotion cyber black-and-grey industry crime. According to the investigation by Jiangsu police cyber units, suspect Chen conspired with Li to develop a hacking program. They colluded with internet cafe operators to illegally install the program on nearly 200,000 computers across more than 5,000 internet cafes in 20 provinces and cities. The program directly altered popular online game configuration files to illicitly capture traffic generated by game promotion systems, claiming game-promoter reward commissions. Jiangsu police arrested 40 suspects with over 6 million yuan involved.
